problem: Blueprint AI is too large; defects slip because broad gates prove existence instead of step-specific quality.

advisors.name: Operator
advisors.recommendation: Break into 30 worker/auditor steps. No stage can proceed without a receipt.

advisors.name: QA
advisors.recommendation: Add a manifest checker that reports each step green/red and blocks preview/send on any red.

advisors.name: Customer Experience
advisors.recommendation: Email visual format must be its own hard gate with screenshot/readback proof.

advisors.name: Scale
advisors.recommendation: Make gates runnable by subagents: each step has inputs, outputs, auditor, pass condition.

advisors.name: Risk
advisors.recommendation: Bennett preview and external send are separate protected gates; no send until all prior steps green.

recommended_architecture: Blueprint Conveyor 30 with worker/auditor receipts, final greenlight manifest, and email format as independent step 23.
